expectations.text: Accepts scope proliferation where resource types genuinely differ in sensitivity instead of collapsing them for tidiness.
expectations.evidence: The draft keeps 12 granular scopes: 4 resources × read/write/delete. It splits `delete` out instead of folding it into `write`. It gives `timesheets:*` its own sensitive tier, justified as 'personal work-hours data and often feed payroll and billing', with admin consent and a distinct consent-screen warning. It sets per-flavour rules, including ❌ for integration `timesheets:delete`. It labels the coarse `full_write` 'discouraged for new apps' and expands it to granular scopes at issue time.
